author: Cleo Abram
description:
Why can’t a robot just click “I’m not a robot”? This tech is called reCAPTCHA, and robots are pretty good at them now!

But it’s not about checking a box! It’s actually tracking other things, like how you move your mouse as you go to check the box.

These tests are about what makes humans… human!

For more optimistic science and tech stories, subscribe!

title: Why Robots Can’t Check “I’m Not A Robot”
